_comment: Listing of every audio file under /public/audio/. Hand-maintained for now — Next.js static export can't directory-list at runtime, so the editor's SoundtrackPicker reads this file to know what tracks are available. Add a new entry whenever you drop a file in this folder. Each `path` is what gets stored on a module / map / dungeon's soundtrack list and is what the SoundtrackPlayer hands to <audio>.src; `name` is the display label in the picker.
